description: Source code for a firmware image utility that reads input files, constructs firmware headers, computes checksums, and writes output files, with support for endianness handling and command-line options.

methods.name: strtou32
methods.description: Converts a string to a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: fwcsum
methods.description: Calculates checksum of a buffer, considering endianness.

methods.name: fwread
methods.description: Reads data from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: fwwrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer to a file.
